desc: Confirm structural characterization: for a fixed center, a spoke v can supply y leaves exactly when deg(v)-1 >= y, and branches never conflict in a tree.
Derive formula: for center c maximize 1 + (y+1)*#{v neighbor of c : deg(v)-1 >= y} over y>=1 with count>=1.
Implement per-center sorting: sort neighbor weights a_v=deg(v)-1 descending, evaluate kept=1+k*(a_(k)+1) for each k with a_(k)>=1, track global max kept; output N - max_kept. Complexity O(N log N).
Handle edge cases: a_v=0 ignored, require x>=1 and y>=1, single-neighbor centers, ties in sorted weights, N as small as 3.
Verify against the three samples and brute-force random small trees (enumerate all centers/y and naively count eligible neighbors) before finalizing.
